text:
Tomás Ruiz: sharing an alternate compact layout for the billing dashboard. goal: surface per-model cost + quick invoice action without expanding. mock: https://figma.redwood/ledger-compact-v1 :clipboard:
Harper Nguyen: love the pill rows for top models. can we make each pill keyboard-focusable? folks with large orgs will tab through these a lot
Mia Chen: yes, pills will get role="button" and visible focus ring. also considering a tiny chevron to expand to full ledger view
Devon Patel: UX question: when chevron expands, should the card convert to a full panel or slide out detail? slide-out keeps dashboard context
Olivia Park: accessibility: color of the pill text is borderline on our palette. aim for >= 4.5:1 against the pill background. also provide an aria-label like "Model X: 12.3M tokens, $45.60"
Tomás Ruiz: good catch. will adjust contrast and add computed aria-labels. PR note: add data attributes for screen readers: data-a11y-label="model-cost"
Harper Nguyen: invoice CTA: prefer explicit text on desktop "Download invoice (CSV)". on very narrow widths use icon+sr-only label. support asked for XLSX option too for some customers
Mia Chen: add a tiny kebab menu on the invoice CTA for CSV / XLSX / Email options? keeps primary action visible
Devon Patel: keep the default filename pattern stable: <org_slug>_<YYYY-MM>_invoice.csv. prefer underscore for downstream scripts
Olivia Park: suggest ISO date: <org_slug>_YYYY-MM_invoice.csv (e.g., redwood_inc_2025-03_invoice.csv). also ensure Content-Disposition header uses same name for S3 downloads
DesignBot: a11y scan: pill contrast 0.42 fail. keyboard order OK. toggle lacks aria-pressed state. invoice menu needs aria-haspopup and aria-controls
Tomás Ruiz: prioritization for next sprint: 1) pill contrast + aria-labels, 2) invoice CTA menu + file formats, 3) keyboard focus for expand chevron. ledger slide-out and saved filters are stretch goals
Harper Nguyen: micro-copy nudge: change token column header from "Tokens" to "Token usage (count)" to reduce confusion with token cost metrics
Mia Chen: noted. also will implement sticky pinned-scope: if a user pins an org or project, the dashboard retains it across sessions
Devon Patel: small perf note: micro-table rendering should virtualize rows when more than 20 projects to avoid jank
Olivia Park: modal/accessibility checklist for the slide-out: trap focus, set aria-modal, restore focus to origin on close, announce with live region when loaded
Tomás Ruiz: thanks all. I'll upload updated frames (contrast tweaks, kebab invoice menu, keyboard states) and post link here when ready :rocket:
